 Follow Carson Daly as Ella Langley and more must-see Halloween costumes from the “Today” show
 The morning show hosts celebrated 100 years of NBC on Friday.
 Shelby Stivale Fri, October 30, 2026 at 2:15 PM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Carson Daly on Halloween
Credit: NBC Key Points
 The Today show anchors revealed their 2026 Halloween costumes during Friday's broadcast.
 The morning show hosts dressed up to celebrate 100 years of NBC by celebrating iconic shows like Friends and Saturday Night Live .
 Savannah Guthrie narrated the entire reveal dressed as an NBC Page.
 Nobody does Halloween quite like the Today show.
 Friday's broadcast brought an epic reveal to the Rockefeller Center Plaza in New York City as the spooky holiday approaches. Savannah Guthrie and Craig Melvin kicked things off as old-timey anchors to introduce this year's theme: celebrating 100 years of NBC.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Guthrie's costume was the first to be revealed. She dressed up as an iconic NBC Page, a highly competitive fellowship for recent college graduates. Guthrie was even joined by comedian Jack McBrayer, who famously played NBC Page Kenneth Parcell in 30 Rock . As Guthrie took some of her cohosts —all in character, of course —through the NBC Studios tour, other costumes were revealed.
 Willie Geist stepped out on the Plaza as late-night talk show host Johnny Carson, who hosted The Tonight Show for 30 seasons from 1962 to 1992. Dylan Dreyer was up next, dressing up as Barbara Eden's Jeannie from I Dream of Jeannie , which ran on NBC from 1965 to 1970.
 Jenna Bush Hager honored Friends by taking on Lisa Kudrow's Phoebe Buffay. And, yes, there was a performance of "Smelly Cat" involved. Bush Hager's actual cat, Maisie , made a guest appearance, so did Guthrie dressed as Jennifer Aniston's Rachel Green. ( Friends aired on NBC from 1994 to 2004.)
 'Today' show on Halloween 
 Credit: NBC 
 Saturday Night Live was also honored with Al Roker as Gumby, holding a cigar in his mouth and Emmy Award in his hand. The sketch comedy show, which premiered in 1975, has the most Primetime Emmy Awards in history.
 Advertisement Advertisement One of their final stops on the NBC Studio tour was studio 1A, where the Today show films. They celebrated the morning show with Carson Daly dressed as Ella Langley. Of course, he performed "Choosin' Texas."
 It also wouldn't be NBC without the Olympics getting involved, so Laura Jarrett dressed up as gymnast Simon Biles and Melvin channeled Snoop Dogg, complete with a Martha Stewart cameo. (Snoop has been named NBC's special Olympics correspondent.)
 Savannah Guthrie and Jack McBrayer on Halloween 
 Credit: NBC 
 NBC's location next to Radio City Music Hall allowed for Sheinelle Jones to dress up as a Radio City Rockette — and do a full dance routine. The Halloween fun didn't stop there, however. After the big reveal, all the Today anchors went head-to-head to test their NBC knowledge in a trivia game .
 Team Friends (Bush Hager, Geist, Dreyer, and Jones) beat out Team Seinfeld (Roker, Melvin, Jarrett, and Daly) for their very own Peacock pillows. Whose to day what Halloween 2027 will bring.
